verdict.rationale: Vestd advertises 'Migrate to Vestd' to digitise or move an existing scheme (implying bulk import of historical grants) and lets admins 'distribute equity to one or more recipients' from a share pool, suggesting some multi-recipient issuance capability. However, there's no explicit documentation of a CSV/bulk upload tool, batch grant template, or dedicated ops workflow for issuing many grants at once. Missing for 10: explicit bulk upload/CSV import UI, documentation of batch grant creation, and independent/hands-on confirmation of bulk transaction migration.
